// A record whose name starts with an underscore never captures its class
// name, so its compact constructor body is scanned by the global state.
// Each record below holds one statement keyword form that must not be taken
// for a function name there; the expected result is lizard's own.
record _K0(int x) {
    _K0 {
        if (x > 0) { x = 1; }
    }
}
record _K1(int x) {
    _K1 {
        if (x > 0) { x = 1; } else { x = 2; }
    }
}
record _K2(int x) {
    _K2 {
        for (int i = 0; i < x; i++) { x = i; }
    }
}
record _K3(int x) {
    _K3 {
        while (x > 3) { x = x - 1; }
    }
}
record _K4(int x) {
    _K4 {
        do { x = x + 1; } while (x < 0);
    }
}
record _K5(int x) {
    _K5 {
        switch (x) { case 1: break; default: break; }
    }
}
record _K6(int x) {
    _K6 {
        try { x = 1; } catch (RuntimeException e) { x = 2; } finally { x = 3; }
    }
}
record _K7(int x) {
    _K7 {
        synchronized (this) { x = 4; }
    }
}
record _K8(int x) {
    _K8 {
        return (x);
    }
}
record _K9(int x) {
    _K9 {
        throw (new IllegalStateException());
    }
}
record _K10(int x) {
    _K10 {
        assert (x > 0);
    }
}
record _K11(int x) {
    _K11 {
        break (x);
    }
}
record _K12(int x) {
    _K12 {
        continue (x);
    }
}
record _K13(int x) {
    _K13 {
        x = (x instanceof (Integer) ? 1 : 2);
    }
}
